items.title: Helen Oakley Dance interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 12, 1998
items.q: I was in close touch with Harold Samuels, who’s the librarian at Yale

ctx.x: Well this has really been fascinating.

It’s interesting to talk with you. And I think it’s wonderful what you’re doing, doing this archive. I was in close touch with Harold Samuels, who’s the librarian at Yale, and who’s the man that originally was very impressed with everything Stanley had done, and called Stan and said what about this, and then what about the photographs, and then finally, what about the records, and of course it’s a big archive. And it was really a big step for us too because you know it’s hard to make a living in this world, in…
